isActive.description: Indicates whether the crypto session is actively initialized with encryption

aesKeyHex.description: 64-character hex string representing the 32-byte derived AES-256 key

aesIvHex.description: 32-character hex string representing the 16-byte initialization vector (IV)

numCyclesPower.description: Power of 2 hash iteration rounds for SHA-256 KDF (2^N rounds)
